text: 超级 PTC 模式（DSH Agent 预设）：为新会话加入 PTC 工具呈现和团队委派 persona。启用后只直接调用 run_code，其他工具经生成 SDK 使用；提示 Team Lead 拆分工作、创建共享任务、委派队友并核验结果。适合希望在 DSH 中使用 PTC 和 Agent Teams 协作的用户。需要宿主 PTC runtime 和 Agent Teams experimental bundle，不需额外 API Key。

Super PTC Mode adds PTC tool presentation and delegation guidance to DSH. Agents call run_code directly; other tools use the generated SDK. Its persona guides Leads to split work, delegate tasks, and verify results. Requires a host PTC runtime and Agent Teams bundle; no API key.
想让 DSH 用 run_code 统一调用其他工具，减少直接暴露的工具入口。
Can I give my DSH agent a preset that delegates separate tasks to teammates and checks their work?
超级 PTC 模式的功能「PTC 委派预设」：新增组合 PTC 工具呈现与团队协作提示的 Agent 预设。用户在新会话选择该预设后，Lead 会按提示拆分工作、创建共享任务、委派队友并核验结果。

text:
@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Bundle identity：| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Package | `@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode` |
| Version | 1.0.0 |
| Repository | <https://github.com/zouyuanqing/dsh-super-ptc-mode> |
| Preset id | `super-ptc` |
| Display name | 超级 PTC 模式 (en: Super PTC Mode) |
| Kind | configuration-only: no `index.js`, no build step, no runtime dependencies |
| Patch | `cordis.patch.yml` (declared as `dsh.bundle.patch`) inserts one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row, `preset-super-ptc` |
| License | MIT |

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Bundle identity：The only behaviour this bundle ships is that preset declaration. There is no host plugin code and no client code. The `@local/` scope and `private: true` are intentional: this is a local profile bundle installed from a checkout, not a package published to npm.

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · PTC presentation：The preset mounts `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation` with `mode: ptc`. For agents joined to this preset the tool catalog collapses to the `run_code` transport plus a generated SDK: every other tool is reachable only from inside a `run_code` program as `await tools.<name>(args)`. Independent calls can therefore be batched in one program, which cuts round trips and keeps intermediate output out of the conversation.
@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · The shipped ptc row set：The preset restates the shipped `ptc` composition so that PTC, delegation, and the doctrine stay one coherent preset:

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · The shipped ptc row set：`plugin_manager` and plugin-market tools are disabled inside sessions of this preset, so the agent cannot reconfigure its own profile from a delegated session.

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · The persona suffix: delegation doctrine：The delta against the shipped `ptc` preset is the persona suffix. It is mounted inside the preset composition, so it shadows the deployment persona suffix for sessions of this preset only; other presets and existing chats are unaffected. It renders after the PTC SDK instructions and tool guidance, so the doctrine has the last word on how work is executed. The text must stay free of `{{…}}` prompt-variable syntax because persona text is a strict template.

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · The persona suffix: delegation doctrine：In short, the doctrine tells the Lead to decompose non-trivial work before acting, create shared tasks with acceptance criteria and disjoint write scopes before spawning, keep teammates bounded (typically 1–4) with self-contained briefs, own integration and final verification, and never equate a completion message with verified success.

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Host-scoped tools it relies on：Agent Teams tools are **not** declared by this bundle. They come from the host profile's `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile` bundle: `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, `list_agents`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and the shared task board `team_task_create` / `list` / `get` / `update`.

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Requirements：| Requirement | Why |
|---|---|
| DSH desktop or web **0.2.1-rc.5** or newer | Verified on 0.2.1-rc.5; the bundle uses the same composition surface the shipped `ptc` preset uses. |
| Agent Teams experimental bundle enabled (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`) | Supplies `spawn_teammate`, `send_message`, `list_agents`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and the shared task board. Without it the preset still mounts, but the team tools are absent and the doctrine is unactionable. |
| A composed PTC runtime (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-ptc-runtime-node`; included in the desktop app) | A `ptc` presentation without a PTC runtime is refused at mount time, naming the failing row. |

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Install and select：1. Clone the repository and keep the checkout in place (a local-directory install links it; `files` does not filter a linked directory):

```bash
   git clone https://github.com/zouyuanqing/dsh-super-ptc-mode.git
   ```

2. In DSH, install the bundle from the cloned directory with the `plugin_manager` tool:

```
   plugin_manager  action: install_bundle  target: <absolute path to the cloned dsh-super-ptc-mode directory>
   ```

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Install and select：5. Verify in the new session: the roster and bundle details show the title and icon; the system prompt contains the doctrine; only `run_code` is directly callable and the generated SDK exposes the team tools. See [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for the checked acceptance criteria and a reproduction outline.

The bundle patch is applied before the profile's own `cordis.patch.yml`, so a profile-level override of the row id `preset-super-ptc` wins if an operator edits it.

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Compatibility：Tested on the DSH desktop app **0.2.1-rc.5 on Windows**. The composition is platform-neutral where the shipped `ptc` preset is: it mounts `pwsh` on Windows and `bash` elsewhere, and the rest of the rows are ordinary DSH plugins. UI titles and descriptions follow the DSH locale (`en` / `zh`).

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Files and display metadata：| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | Manifest; `dsh.bundle.patch` → `./cordis.patch.yml`; exports `./locale/*.json`, `./icon`, `./cordis.patch.yml` |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | The preset declaration — the composition this bundle exists for |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | `meta.title` + `meta.description`, read by Plugin Manager and Settings without activating a plugin |
| `icon.svg` | Original artwork, square `0 0 64 64`: a dark tile, three connected team nodes with the Lead node in the centre, and a lightning bolt for PTC speed. No external references, fonts, or embedded raster; ~1 KB |
| `screenshots/preset-picker.png` | The DSH preset picker showing 超级 PTC 模式 next to the shipped modes |
| `docs/VERIFICATION.md` | Public verification summary: acceptance table, evidence statements, reproduce outline |
| `LICENSE` | MIT |

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Verification：The bundle was verified end to end on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5: the preset appears in the roster, a real session mounts it, the persisted system prompt contains the doctrine verbatim, the request header exposes only `run_code`, the generated SDK declares all nine Agent Teams bindings, and a real teammate plus shared-task flow completed. Details, per-criterion results, and how to reproduce them are in [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · Removal：Disable or remove the bundle in DSH plugin management (`plugin_manager` `set_bundle` / `remove_bundle`); the preset row disappears with it. Removing it does not touch the Agent Teams bundle.

@local/dsh-super-ptc-mode README · 中文摘要：- **组成**：一个 Agent 预设「超级 PTC 模式」（id `super-ptc`）。工具呈现为 PTC：只直接暴露 `run_code`，其余工具由生成的 SDK 在程序内调用；agent 复刻官方 `ptc` 预设的工具行，并额外注入预设作用域内的「超级委派」系统提示。
- **依赖**：需要宿主 Profile 启用 Agent Teams 包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team-profile`（提供 `spawn_teammate`、`send_message`、`list_agents`、`wait_agent`、`interrupt_agent` 和共享任务板）；还需要 PTC 运行时（桌面版自带）。需 DSH 0.2.1-rc.5 或更新版本。
- **安装**：`git clone` 本仓库后，在 DSH 中用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle` 指向克隆目录；按结果刷新或重启，然后在新会话中选择「超级 PTC 模式」预设。本地目录安装会链接该检出目录，请保留它。
- **验证**：验收标准、逐项证据与复现步骤见 [docs/VERIFICATION.md](docs/VERIFICATION.md)。
